# Remaining Blockers

## Empirical / external
- Production general-text proposal model certification.
- Independent reviewer model certification.
- Independent blind-recall model certification.
- Real-source semantic precision/recall benchmark.
- True image/figure semantic model certification.
- Public native source canaries where network/DNS is required.
- Actual current 09D SQLite artifact comparison if not mounted.
- PostgreSQL/BigQuery target execution only where those deployment targets are actually required.

## Scale proof
- Real-provider concurrency soak.
- Provider-failure/failover test.
- Long unattended mass extraction.

Offline fixture success does not satisfy these empirical gates.
